last_run: Weekly upgrade. Good news: this morning the smarter pick-ranker (a neural network) passed all its safety checks on past calls it never saw and switched on for the first time. But the app was using it half-and-half with the old ranking, a mix nobody had tested, so in about 1 of 4 new beliefs the #1 pick shown was not the one the network actually chose. Fixed: when the network passes on its own, it now picks the #1 on its own, exactly as it was tested. This goes live once Render builds work again.
working_on: Making sure what users see is exactly what passed the tests.
next: After the next deploy: check that every new #1 pick is the network's own choice, then watch whether real-time #1 picks do better than before (first 30-day results mid December).
